Veterans Benefits: Beginning tax year 2026 Georgia exempts up to $65,000 of military retirement pay regardless of age (prior law limited the full exclusion to age 65+). Georgia also provides a disabled-veteran homestead property-tax exemption for qualifying 100% service-connected disabled veterans and eligible survivors, with the amount adjusted annually.

Description: Augusta is a consolidated city-county on the Savannah River, home to Fort Eisenhower (formerly Fort Gordon), the Army's Cyber Center of Excellence and Army Cyber Command. It offers the in-city Charlie Norwood VA Medical Center, low housing costs, Costco access, and Georgia's expanded military-retirement tax exclusion. Tradeoffs include an elevated crime rate, hot humid summers, and limited local LGBTQ protections.
